ATC — J01DD10. ATC Vet — QJ01DD10. Profile Cefetamet is a third-generation cephalosporin antibacterial simi- lar to cefixime (below). It has been given orally as the hydrochlo- ride of the pivaloyloxymethyl ester, cefetamet pivoxil hydro- chloride, which is hydrolysed to cefetamet in vivo. The usual dose is 500 mg twice daily.
